cat > $D/deepseek-sign-in.sh <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Show OpenClaw's own Chrome on the Windows desktop (WSLg :0) long enough for
# its owner to sign in to chat.deepseek.com, then put it back on the hidden
# Xvfb :9. The switch is a runtime drop-in: it is removed on exit, and a distro
# restart drops it anyway, so the persistent :9 setup is never edited.
set -u
TIMEOUT_S="${SIGNIN_TIMEOUT:-900}"
UNIT=openclaw-gateway.service
DROP="${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}/systemd/user/$UNIT.d"
B="openclaw browser --browser-profile openclaw"
PATH_JS='() => location.pathname'

restore() {
  rm -f "$DROP/20-deepseek-sign-in.conf"
  systemctl --user daemon-reload
  systemctl --user restart "$UNIT"
  echo "[sign-in] browser back on the hidden display"
}

wait_gateway() {
  for _ in $(seq 1 90); do $B status >/dev/null 2>&1 && return 0; sleep 1; done
  return 1
}

pathname() {
  $B --timeout 30000 evaluate --json --timeout-ms 20000 --fn "$PATH_JS" 2>/dev/null \
    | grep -o '"result": *"[^"]*"' | sed 's/.*"\([^"]*\)"$/\1/'
}

mkdir -p "$DROP"
printf '[Service]\nEnvironment=DISPLAY=:0\n' > "$DROP/20-deepseek-sign-in.conf"
trap restore EXIT
systemctl --user daemon-reload
systemctl --user restart "$UNIT"
wait_gateway || { echo "[sign-in] FAIL: gateway did not come back"; exit 2; }

OK=0; for _ in $(seq 1 60); do $B open https://chat.deepseek.com/sign_in >/dev/null 2>&1 && { OK=1; break; }; sleep 1; done
[ "$OK" = 1 ] || { echo "[sign-in] FAIL: could not open DeepSeek"; exit 3; }
echo "[sign-in] DeepSeek sign-in window is open on the desktop. Waiting up to ${TIMEOUT_S}s for sign-in..."

T0=$(date +%s)
while :; do
  P="$(pathname)"
  case "$P" in
    ""|/sign_in*|/sign_up*) ;;
    *) echo "[sign-in] signed in (page: $P)"; break ;;
  esac
  if [ $(( $(date +%s) - T0 )) -ge "$TIMEOUT_S" ]; then echo "[sign-in] TIMEOUT: still on sign-in page"; exit 4; fi
  sleep 3
done
sleep 3  # let the session cookie settle before Chrome is restarted
exit 0
EOF
cat > $D/deepseek-live-check.ts <<'EOF'
// One live DeepSeek round trip through the real gateway; prints the reply or the reason.
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import { resolveOptions } from '../src/index.ts'
import { buildSpec, parseReply } from '../src/transport.ts'

const options = resolveOptions({ site: 'deepseek' })
const spec = buildSpec(options, 'Reply with exactly: PONG', AbortSignal.timeout(300_000))
const t0 = Date.now()
const child = spawn(spec.argv[0]!, spec.argv.slice(1), { stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'inherit'] })
let out = ''
child.stdout.on('data', (d: Buffer) => { out += d.toString() })
child.stdin.end((spec.stdio as { stdin: { data: string } }).stdin.data)
child.on('close', () => {
  const seconds = ((Date.now() - t0) / 1000).toFixed(1)
  try {
    console.log(`[live-check] DeepSeek replied in ${seconds}s: ${JSON.stringify(parseReply(out))}`)
  } catch (error) {
    console.log(`[live-check] FAIL after ${seconds}s: ${(error as Error).message}`)
    process.exitCode = 1
  }
})
EOF
